F · What this does and does not show

It shows how these exact notebook classes behave on two small tasks, averaged over three seeds, with the spread shown. It does not show what the changes do at the scale of real language models: there, the evidence for
comes from the papers cited on each page and from how widely they were adopted.
code works and does not hurt — or catch it hurting — but small differences here should not be read as general truths.
